x.instructions: For world position x, read state.processed_features.axes.x.goal_relation. Select positive for increase, negative for decrease, hold for within_tolerance. Geometry is program-supplied context, not a contact sensor.

criteria.negative: Decrease this world component toward its target.
criteria.hold: This component is within its specified tolerance.
criteria.positive: Increase this world component toward its target.
